name: prevent_objectflags_identicalbasetypeexi_5b10466b
subject: Prevent `ObjectFlags.IdenticalBaseTypeExists` and `ObjectFlags.IsConstrainedTypeVariable` confusion (#56711)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Union reduction confused IdenticalBaseTypeExists and IsConstrainedTypeVariable object flags, which share a bit. The fix adds a check for the Intersection type flag before reading the constrained-type-variable flag, which avoids a crash.
